newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - July 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - July 9.

text.p: the Ivorian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these
items and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Minister of Planning and Industrial Development Theophile Ahoua N'Doli tells industrialists to conquer new markets, says the 60 percent import tax relief allowed since July 1 on imports within the Economic and Monetary Union of West African States (UEMOA) puts them in a strong competitive position.
-Jean-Claude Anoh, head of the state forestry agent (SODEFOR), says the remaining forest area could disappear in 10 years if the government does not take tougher action against uncontrolled felling.

- Aid donors see decentralisation in Ivory Coast as a priority in the fight against poverty, a seminar heard on Tuesday. Finance Minister Niamien N'Goran said the European Union wanted to channel aid to the private sector and non-government groups. (1$=585 CFA)
